obligations.ask: Attend the council tax account appointment

results.segment: We are writing to confirm your council tax account appointment with Kelsford Borough Council on 4 May 2026 at 3.50pm.
Please allow fifteen minutes for parking, and bring a list of anything you are currently taking.
Should you need to rearrange, our booking line is open on weekdays.
Cover runs to 30 November and continues automatically thereafter.
